pr.title: fix(average): handle empty input and raise the batch limit
pr.body:
## Summary
Return zero for empty input in average(), and raise MAX_BATCH_ITEMS from 100 to 250.

## Rationale
Empty inputs currently raise ZeroDivisionError; returning zero preserves the caller's
empty-report convention. Raising the batch limit reduces requests for a workload
that commonly contains 200 items; 250 retains an explicit upper bound.

## Testing
The validation plan covers empty and ordinary averages, acceptance of 250 items,
and rejection of 251 items. These tests are described here, not executed by this fixture.
